[LTIM.1.3.5] **A `Duration` is a value of the `time` dimension.** `Duration` is
the one static type of every value of that dimension: a `time`-dimensioned unit
literal, a slot or service kwarg typed by a `time` unit or by `time`
([LUNI.7.1]), a `::<time unit>` cast, and each `Duration`-valued row of
[LTIM.4.1.1]. The compiler **must** type them alike, so [LTIM.4.1] and the rules
of [LUNI.8] reach each of them, and **must not** type a value of the dimension as
a `Float`, or as an `Int` with a dimension.

The `time` unit declared on a slot or a kwarg says how the value displays
([LUNI.11.1]) and how it is delivered ([LADP.8.5]), and names no other type. The
compiler **must** refuse a bitwise operator on a `Duration` with
`DS_VALIDATE_BITWISE_TYPE` ([LEXP.7.7]).
